subject: Finalizing: Technical screen schedule + debrief plan for Ethan Ruiz
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate confirmed — Ethan Ruiz (ML engineer) & preferred windows

Hi team,

Ethan confirmed and accepted our technical screen. He prefers mornings PST and is available the week of Aug 23 — ideal windows are 9:00–11:30am PT on Tue/Wed/Thu. Attaching his resume and the calendar .ics for the candidate-facing slot.

We discussed a two-part screen: 45m coding (core systems/data structures) + 45m ML design (modeling choices + evaluation). Proposed interviewer split below — open to swaps:

- Coding (45m): Alex Martinez (interviewer) + Ben Carter (proctor/eval)
- ML design (45m): Markus Klein (hiring manager) + Kimberly Park (metrics/eval)

Goal: keep the session tightly timed, share the CoderPad link at start, and use the attached eval rubric. Monica will send candidate prep instructions and confirm final time once you sign off.

Attachments: Ethan_Ruiz_Resume.pdf, eval-rubric.pdf, coderpad-invite.ics

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Candidate confirmed — Ethan Ruiz (ML engineer) & preferred windows

Thanks, Monica — all good on my side. I can take the coding half on Tue Aug 24 at 9:00am PT. Ben, can you be the proctor and take notes?

Quick logistics:
- I'll prepare a short warm-up prompt (~10m) then move to the main problem (35m).
- CoderPad session: https://coderpad.io/session/ABC123 — please do not share publicly, we'll paste it into the calendar invite.
- Candidate should be told to bring a laptop with a browser and that we allow Python/JS. No access to internet docs except our shared prompts.

If Markus prefers Wed for ML design, happy to swap — otherwise the proposed Tue/Wed split works for me.
